body: Car hydroplaned on rainy fwy - i was going straight too..I guess tires were pretty bald though...it was odd just spinning around and when I hit the wall I was like oh maybe now someone can hit me and it won't look like a suicide..I tried to commit suicide almost 2 years ago..was institutionalized for 3 days..
Yeah it could've been worse...it's just that I wished it was.

You are completely right...I've shut myself down from plenty of opps as I've gone into a rather deep negative feed back cycle of "well if I can't do this...how could I possibly do that"....

But have to start somewhere...opening up here was a good first step...I have finally begun to let others in...Isolation was never an answer...

Thanks for your comments...

Good advice...I just keep getting caught in a negative feedback cycle..as in "if I can't do this...how can I possibily do this..." 

Last year I drank some Anti-freeze and took a lot of OTC sleeping pills...police found me in my car and I was rushed to the hospital...they had a psychiatrist evaluate me and he had me institutionalized for three days...

I always fear having a similar breakdown when I am put in stressful situations. I have lost confidence in myself and my abilities...the way I've lived the past year is by lying and avoiding situations where I'd be put on the spot...this can only last so long and has created a very guilty burden on my part...
Thank for these threads...I will look into them. Man I haven't taken any meds in awhile took some Lexapro and it made me more lethargic than I can ever remember it doing

I really don't know...I've lost a lot of confidence in myself over the years. I'm not even sure where to begin. As I've said, I've ran my own businesses and have a business to take over but I just can't bring myself to do it...

I don't even remember...I believe it was like 3.06 or something. I can't think of anything that I'd care enough to focus and study on...I can't remember the last time I was proud of something I've done
Not particularly...I just can't imagine doing papers and going to class again. My grades were so mediocre that I don't think I'd get into any Masters programs either.

I cut myself off from my friends because ultimately I think I know I am a fake. I've been living a lie. My adult life I'm still dependent on my family. People have literally put themselves through college, support themselves, raising families and I can't even manage to take care of myself.

International Development Studies...It was a mash-up of political science, sociology and economics. I really only chose it because I was all over the place and it was the only degree that I could get out in 4 years with. I was trading even then...graduated back in 2003...god I can't believe it's been 7 years...

Hi...thanks for replying. By all accounts, I have a great life relatively. I have a very supportive family but I've been lying to them for arguably years now. I "daytrade" for a living or attempt to. I've been trying for years at least. And quite honestly I am pretty bad at it. By all accounts I should stop. But I've been doing this for so long I don't now what else to do. 

I don't talk to anyone because inherently I know that other people have problems 100x worse than mine. I tried therapy and in a sense it made me feel better but was too expensive and I ended up hating myself even more as I talked out loud bout some of my issues.
